name: ECommerce-RAG-Faithfulness-Suite
description: Validates groundedness and anti-hallucination guardrails for product returns RAG pipeline

rules.response: According to our policy, unopened merchandise can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a 100% refund.
All electronic devices carry a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects.
The price of the item is $999.00 with a 50-year warranty.

test_cases.name: Return Policy Groundedness
test_cases.prompt: How many days do I have to return an unopened item?
context: Store Return Policy: Unopened merchandise can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a 100% refund. Opened items incur a 15% restocking fee.

test_cases.name: Electronics Warranty Check
test_cases.prompt: What is the warranty period for electronics?
context: Warranty Terms: All electronic devices carry a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects. Accidental liquid damage is excluded.
